name: buzz-bridge
description: Buzz seat-listener wake bridge: wakes an idle Claude Code session when Buzz for-me mail arrives. Requires bun and a running buzz-seat-clerk.
author: Civilization Agency
notes: The claude/channel MCP capability used by this plugin is experimental.
Claude Code must be launched with --experimental-channels (or equivalent flag).
This flag may change in future Claude Code versions.
The plugin is content-free: it never reads message bodies or holds keys.
Template variables (pluginDir, env.HOME) may not be supported in all Claude Code versions. Use install.sh for a reliable one-step install.
